name: Semiloft
title: Architectural flat and round
description: A heavy architectural display face balancing planar cuts and flat stems with circular bowls. Compact lowercase and deep counters suit short headings, identities and editorial display.
story: Bauhaus 93 inspired the modular mass. The selected architectural-flat-round-v3 B is OpenAI raster artwork, including its expressly selected, separately generated M patch. Both originals and patch provenance are retained. Tracing and bounded cleanup preserve that choice; authored companions, optical spacing and explicit layout support extend it to the agreed union plus dotless j.
independent_review: Current final package cleared in integration handoff
distribution_terms: Pending owner review. No redistribution license is assigned to these sample font assets. The repository compiler license is unchanged.
build_boundary: Documented project-local compatibility adapter runs the pinned Fontify compiler and gated review; plain JSON CLI cannot directly admit blank NBSP/zero-advance marks. Producer source-stage, compiled and release records are distinct from the integration binary checks.
limitations: Display use from 32px; body text and smaller sizes are not certified.
Exact listed coverage and documented language/one- or two-mark samples only. Arbitrary accent stacks, every Latin orthography and every rendering engine are not certified.
Static Regular TTF/WOFF2 only; no CFF OTF, variable axes or additional styles.
Chrome discretionary-hyphen pixels differ positionally from the forced-hyphen reference; native-font semantics pass.
Spacing used bounded plans and inheritance; a full all-pair optical solver was not run.
